Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

We will continue with module seven on functional materials that is polymers and today's class we are going to talk about conducting polymers, a brief introduction, the types of dopamine, the applications of conducting polymers.

Key details

  • Polymers are generally known for their insulating property because the organic molecules of which they are composed have no free electrons to carry current.
  • An organic polymer with highly delocalized pi electron system and having an electrical conductance of the order of an electrical conductor.

  • And if you have doped polyaniline, it is found to have 10 to the power of 5 sements per meter.
  • These are also known as synthetic metals.
